What's new in DuckOS 1.0.96

• Home screen: put apps anywhere, right up to the top of the screen. Hold an app and drag it to any spot.
• The big clock can be moved or removed: hold it and drag it, or choose "Remove from home". Add it back with "Add a widget".
• Add any app's widget straight to the home screen: hold an empty spot, tap "Add a widget" and pick one. Hold a widget to move it, resize it or remove it.
• Recent apps: Medical ID, DuckAntivirus, DuckMaps and the other DuckOS screens show their own icons instead of the DuckOS ring.
• DuckAI's picture and message words in German and Turkish.
